title: Concept: HTML parsing insertion via insertAdjacentHTML (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, insertAdjacentHTML converts a string into nodes instead of text. A value that reaches it from a URL, storage or an API therefore becomes executable markup, including event-handler attributes. Insert text with textContent, or sanitize markup first.
applicability: javascript browser code that renders server or user supplied strings; lexical scope.
risk: Script execution in the victim origin; MEDIUM severity.
